items.title: The Champagne of Makgeolli
items.subtitle: Creamy organic rice wine with a remarkably clean finish. Korea's most celebrated makgeolli.

items.title: Slow-Brewed Perfection
items.subtitle: From a master brewer who revived forgotten techniques. Silky layers you won't forget.

items.title: The Classic Starter
items.subtitle: Brewed since 1925. The perfect first makgeolli for any newcomer to Korean drinks.

items.title: Bubbly Rice Prosecco
items.subtitle: Fine bubbles meet bright acidity. Serve chilled in a wine glass for the full experience.

items.title: 500 Years of Busan Soul
items.subtitle: Hand-pressed nuruk, 100% rice. Fuller body and a bold character from Korea's southern coast.

items.title: Seoul's Pub Classic
items.subtitle: Found at every traditional Korean pub. The go-to draft makgeolli for a real local experience.

items.title: Spoonable Rice Wine
items.subtitle: A Goryeo-dynasty recipe so thick you eat it with a spoon. Unlike anything you've tried.

items.title: Named After a Folktale
items.subtitle: Light, slightly sweet, from the Chunhyangjeon legend. Easy drinking for any occasion.

items.title: Pink Rice Wine
items.subtitle: Naturally colored with red rice — no artificial anything. Gorgeous, wine-like, Instagram-ready.

items.title: Craft Beer Meets Tradition
items.subtitle: Seoul micro-brewery making crisp, slightly carbonated makgeolli for the modern palate.

items.title: A Friendship Worth Sharing
items.subtitle: Named after a proverb about deep friendship. Rich, floral, best enjoyed with good company.

items.title: Your Fun Starter Drink
items.subtitle: Banana-flavored makgeolli that's a party favorite. Sweet, easy, and everyone's first Korean drink.

items.title: Floating Rice Magic
items.subtitle: Watch rice grains float in your bowl. A rustic style of makgeolli with earthy charm.

items.title: The House-Made Original
items.subtitle: Brewed with hand-crafted nuruk starter. Taste what makgeolli was like centuries ago.

items.title: Jeju Island in a Glass
items.subtitle: Made with Jeju millet and volcanic water. A taste of the island you can't get anywhere else.

items.title: Korea's Finest Spirit
items.subtitle: Triple-distilled from 100% rice. At 41%, this is soju elevated to whisky-level sophistication.

items.title: The Smooth Upgrade
items.subtitle: Premium rice soju at an approachable 25%. A huge step up from convenience store bottles.

items.title: Premium Goes Easy
items.subtitle: Hwayo's most accessible expression. Premium rice soju quality at a gentle 17% ABV.

items.title: Heritage Spirit of Andong
items.subtitle: Traditional distillation passed down for generations. Bold, complex, and deeply Korean.

items.title: The Gold Standard
items.subtitle: Andong Soju's ultimate expression at 40%. For the serious spirit enthusiast only.

items.title: Volcanic Island Soju
items.subtitle: From Jeju's Hallasan mountain water. Uniquely smooth with a mineral character all its own.

items.title: Korea's #1 Drink
items.subtitle: The world's best-selling spirit. Every Korean has a Chamisul story — now it's your turn.

items.title: Peachy & Playful
items.subtitle: Fruity soju that started a global trend. Sweet peach flavor makes soju approachable for everyone.

items.title: Green Grape Crush
items.subtitle: The viral green grape soju. Light, sweet, and the reason fruit soju took over the world.

items.title: Smooth as a Good Day
items.subtitle: The softest soju on the market. Clean finish that lives up to its optimistic name.

items.title: Like the First Time
items.subtitle: Alkaline water base makes this the smoothest mainstream soju. Gentle on the throat.

items.title: Retro Gold Revival
items.subtitle: Jinro's premium throwback to the original 1970s recipe. 24% of golden nostalgia.

items.title: The Phantom Pear
items.subtitle: Smells like pear but contains no fruit. An intangible cultural heritage distilled into a bottle.

items.title: Ginger-Pear Alchemy
items.subtitle: Steeped with pear, ginger, turmeric, and cinnamon. A 500-year-old Korean herbal spirit.

items.title: Triple-Distilled Legend
items.subtitle: Three layers of distillation, infused with rare herbs. One of Korea's most precious spirits.

items.title: Jeju's Ancient Fire
items.subtitle: Distilled in a traditional clay 'gosori' pot on Jeju island. Raw, powerful, unforgettable.

items.title: The Ultimate Hwayo
items.subtitle: At 53%, this is Korea's answer to cask-strength whisky. For collectors and connoisseurs.

items.title: Thousand-Year Royal Wine
items.subtitle: Once served to Silla dynasty royalty. Clear, refined, and steeped in a millennium of history.

items.title: Clear Rice Elegance
items.subtitle: The most approachable cheongju. Think of it as Korean sake — clean, light, and versatile.

items.title: The Intoxicating Brew
items.subtitle: So good it once kept scholars from studying. Sweet, layered, and dangerously drinkable.

items.title: 100-Year-Life Wine
items.subtitle: Brewed with ginseng and 12 herbs. The health-conscious Korean's drink of choice.

items.title: Autumn Harvest Elixir
items.subtitle: A refined rice wine with chrysanthemum and herbal notes. Tastes like Korean autumn.

items.title: Mountain Berry Bliss
items.subtitle: Made with wild Korean hawthorn berries. Sweet-tart and beautifully balanced.

items.title: Crystal-Clear Temptation
items.subtitle: The clear version of the famous Sogokju. Same legendary taste, refined presentation.

items.title: Plum Blossom in a Glass
items.subtitle: Korea's most popular fruit wine. Delicate plum flavor that pairs with everything.

items.title: Wild Berry Power
items.subtitle: Deep purple Korean black raspberry wine. Bold, fruity, and famous for its 'stamina' reputation.

items.title: Green Plum Refresher
items.subtitle: Every Korean home has a jar of this. Tangy, sweet, and the ultimate summer sipper.

items.title: Five Flavors, One Sip
items.subtitle: Sweet, sour, salty, bitter, and spicy — all from one tiny omija berry. A Korean marvel.

items.title: Jeju Tangerine Wine
items.subtitle: Sunshine-sweet Jeju tangerines turned into wine. Bright, citrusy, and impossibly cheerful.

items.title: Citrus from the South
items.subtitle: Korean yuzu wine from Goheung. Fragrant, tart, and a perfect aperitif.

items.title: Pomegranate Poetry
items.subtitle: Ruby-red pomegranate wine. Light, elegant, and surprisingly complex for a fruit wine.

items.title: Wild Grape Discovery
items.subtitle: Korean wild mountain grapes make a tannic, earthy wine unlike any Western grape wine.

items.title: Korean Blanc
items.subtitle: A modern Korean fruit wine with white wine aspirations. Fresh, floral, and date-night ready.

items.title: Korea's Own Grape Wine
items.subtitle: Korean-grown grapes, Korean-made wine. A surprisingly good domestic grape wine.

items.title: Sweet Persimmon Nectar
items.subtitle: Made from Korea's prized persimmons. Honey-sweet, autumn-scented, completely unique.

items.title: Chrysanthemum Ceremony
items.subtitle: Steeped with autumn chrysanthemum flowers. Floral, herbal, and deeply traditional.

items.title: Azalea Flower Wine
items.subtitle: Made with wild azalea petals. A rare, beautiful, and almost mythical Korean brew.

items.title: Sweet Rice Starter
items.subtitle: Barely alcoholic and naturally sweet. The gentlest introduction to Korean fermented drinks.

items.title: Korea's Signature Mix
items.subtitle: Soju + beer = somaek. Learn the golden ratio and drink like a real Korean.

items.title: Grandma s Bold Recipe
items.subtitle: Thick, earthy, countryside-style makgeolli from Pocheon. Not for the faint-hearted.

items.title: Best Budget Find
items.subtitle: Complex, grainy makgeolli at convenience store prices. 100% rice, real nuruk.
